parsed.note_claim: Walmart is NOT closing stores to in-person shopping on November 1st, and there is no connection between EBT/SNAP benefits and any store closures.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: However, the claims are false, as Walmart has not announced any closure of its physical stores, and certainly not due to the lapse of SNAP benefits.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly states the rumor is false and confirms Walmart has not announced any closure of physical stores.
